name: Cube a Ton in Arlington 2024
information: Note: This competition is on a Sunday. - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAToninArlington2024#49304-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAToninArlington2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. ## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue, however it is permitted in the foyer outside the expo hall.*** This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
